title: Settings
description: Manage your profile, password security, active device sessions, and interface preferences.

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: Update your display name, email address, and avatar. Changes sync immediately across the console.
profile.avatarHint: Supports JPG, PNG, WebP, or GIF up to {{maxSize}}. The server resizes and strips all EXIF metadata.
profile.avatarInvalidType: Only JPG, PNG, WebP, or GIF images are supported
profile.usernameHint: Username cannot be changed after account creation.
profile.displayNameHint: Leaving this blank falls back to your username.
profile.basicInfoDesc: Edit your display name and contact email. Changes sync across the console immediately.
profile.allChangesSaved: All profile details are up to date

security.title: Security & Password
security.description: Use a strong, unique password to keep your account protected.
security.newPasswordHint: Must be 8 to 128 characters. Spaces and all Unicode characters are allowed.
security.revokeOtherSessionsHint: Immediately revoke all other active sessions after changing your password (recommended).
security.updatedWithRevoked: Password updated and {{count}} other session(s) revoked

sessions.title: Active Sessions
sessions.description: Review devices currently signed in to your account and revoke any unrecognized session.
sessions.revokeAllDesc: All {{count}} other active session(s) will be revoked immediately and require signing in again.
sessions.revokedAllNone: No other active sessions to revoke
sessions.currentDeviceNote: Use Sign out in the sidebar menu to end the current session
sessions.revokeDesc: The session on {{device}} (IP: {{ip}}) will no longer be able to refresh its token and must sign in again.
sessions.emptyDesc: No active sessions were found for this account.

appearance.title: Appearance & Language
appearance.description: Customize the console theme, sidebar layout, and display language.
appearance.themeDescription: Choose the color scheme for the console. Changes apply immediately.
appearance.languageDescription: Switches both UI labels and localized backend responses, role names, and menus.
appearance.layoutDescription: Adjust the sidebar presentation and collapse behavior.
